verdict.rationale: Letta's docs show memory is agent-scoped by default (each agent has its own memory blocks/files) and cross-agent access requires explicitly creating 'shared memory' repositories, implying isolation unless opted in [letta-docs-8][letta-docs-21][letta-docs-29][letta-docs-11]. However, there is no explicit documentation of multi-tenant/user-level scoping, access-control policies, or guarantees that one user's/application's memories cannot leak into another's retrieval in shared or multi-user deployments (e.g., cloud/app-server mode). missing for 10: explicit tenant/user isolation guarantees, permission model docs, and any evidence addressing cross-tenant leakage prevention in shared or cloud-hosted setups.
